_comment: Our own items. Each clones an existing client item template ('base': model, icon, slot, class rules) under a new id. Read by the server (Game/CustomItems.cs) and, via CH.Patcher, by the client mod (CHPrivateMods.CustomItems). Ids start at 90001 (the client's highest is 78974).

items.name: Rainbow Trident
items.description: A Greater Black Trident caught in the light of every colour at once. It shimmers through the rainbow as you fight.
